title: Machine learning flags critical spinal epidural lesions on CT in a teleradiology workflow
summary: A model trained on 153 studies with segmented epidural lesions was tested on missed lesions (50.0% sensitivity, 99.0% specificity) and then run for 90 days in a teleradiology workflow, where it prioritised 66.7% of 18 lesions at 98.9% specificity and about two flags per day, and found 17 missed lesions. Sensitivity is modest and lesion numbers are small.
ai_technology: Machine learning model trained on segmented CT epidural lesions

evidence.tested: Sensitivity and specificity on a missed-lesion test set and in 90 days of integrated teleradiology use.
evidence.unknown: Modest sensitivity; small lesion numbers; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Machine learning model screening CT studies for critical epidural lesions.
